facts: P17 CaptureSequence keeps one plan/index and coordinated applied/in-flight/view counters; can_drive_frame prevents replaying motion while screenshot callbacks advance views. Admission rejection is terminal and differs from bounded readiness waits. All scoped bodies read, including tests as source only.

P17 repeated-evaluation baseline is explicitly a historical observation of the first view, keyed by full scenario/frame; subsequent views compare equal bone keysets, pose deltas, contact/landing/events and IK state. Cumulative validity cannot recover after mismatch. No assertion of execution or image quality from this source review.

P17 fixture drives planned look every render, retains actual semantic-route selected/requested paths and emits skeleton action/phase observations. Planned speed and expected body direction remain expected input, not proof of actual motion; sample recipient/acceptance consumer must preserve that role.

P17 capture-ground enum distinguishes terrain observation from authored no-IK root plane. Terrain footprint failure remains an optional clearance observation; invalid retained signed clearance is explicit GeometryResult failure. Full-ragdoll and quickstep fixture roots are authored diagnostics, not tactical server authority.

P17 Bouncy telemetry is aggregate over rigs while frame subject is single; ordinary viewer installs one CaptureSubject, but extra rigs and aggregate-to-subject association remain conditional instrumentation dependency, not proven current multiple-subject mismatch.

P17 capture samples preserve local raised-footwork contact-sequence ownership even uninitialized, and use explicit cadence fallback only when ordinary IK ownership not required; missing required IK weight rejects rather than fabricating flight. Root/desired/bone observations are orthogonal facts.

P17 global bone report filters AuthoredBindTransform.owner against subject and preserves target identity plus optional display name; stable sort is display order, not identity replacement. Exact P17 wrappers and call sites considered independently from PR variants; no other-lens verdict transferred.

P17 run invalidates previous report, installs explicit diagnostic combatconfig and fixed clock, and opts out authoritative tactical simulation; diagnostic default mirror and scenario selection remain audit inventory obligations, not live gameplay execution evidence.
